This is a role for someone who straddles the line between data engineering and AI — someone who can write a solid ETL pipeline in the morning and help shape an AI workflow in the afternoon. If you're curious about what's possible, comfortable with ambiguity, and energised by turning early-stage ideas into working systems, this could be a great fit.    What you'll be doing
Designing and building data pipelines and ETL processes that are reliable and maintainable
Writing and optimising SQL queries (including MySQL) and using Python for data processing and analysis
Applying prompt engineering techniques as part of AI-driven workflows
Translating stakeholder requirements into technical solutions — the kind of brief that goes "here's the dataset, figure out the logic"
Supporting the development of AI agents — including human-in-the-loop systems and analysis of model outputs (call analysis, performance review, etc.)
Helping move prototypes toward production — iterating with PMs and internal stakeholders along the way
What we're looking for  
Solid data engineering experience — pipelines, ETL, SQL, Python
Exposure to or genuine interest in AI/ML and prompt engineering — you don't need to be an expert, but you need to be engaged
Comfortable with ambiguity — this isn't a role with a fully mapped-out spec on day one
A practical, delivery-focused mindset — willing to share early drafts, take feedback, and keep moving
Clear communication skills — you can translate technical work for non-technical stakeholders without losing the detail 
This role will be 5 days on site - location is East Tamaki.  
Nice to haveExperience on AI-driven products or automation workflows · Exposure to unstructured data (voice, text, etc.) · A background that spans both engineering and analytics — you enjoy both sides of the houseIf you’re interested in having a conversation about this role or any future opportunities that might be aligned for you, please email marian@rwa.co.nz!
